title: OpenVIBES v1 shared definitions
description: Byte limits in spec/contracts-v1.md are authoritative. maxLength counts characters, so it bounds ASCII fields exactly and non-ASCII fields only loosely; implementations must also check UTF-8 byte length.

schemaVersion.description: Wire schema version; readers reject any other value.

identifier.description: 1 to 128 ASCII letters, digits, dots, underscores, colons, or hyphens.

boundedString.description: Non-empty; at most 4096 UTF-8 bytes; never contains U+0000 (NUL).

csrPem.description: PEM PKCS#10 request signed by the key being certified.
